authorities.weather_spec: ultimate_pipeline/perception/environment/weather_spec.py (Candidate B) - resolve, normalize, v2 identity, apply+verify, per-arm binding
authorities.camera_response: ultimate_pipeline/perception/environment/camera_response.py (Candidate B) - photometric profile, separate from weather

frame_driven_deterministic_weather.mechanism: DeterministicWeatherController.step_for_frame(frame_id) is a pure function of (seed, preset list, ticks_per_step, frame_id); tick() applies the entry governing that frame

no_unseeded_wallclock_background_random_.mechanism: the controller owns random.Random(self.seed); build_schedule draws only from that instance and its output is a function of (seed, presets) only. Verified that a full schedule walk plus step_for_frame leaves the process-global RNG bit-identical.

weather_spec_id.mechanism: resolve_weather_spec returns a spec whose parameters are hashed by weather_identity_v2 (schema weather_effective_v2)

weather_seed.mechanism: controller seed is explicit; schedule_sha256 payload includes weather_seed and mode

frame_index_schedule.mechanism: scheduled mode yields start_frame/end_frame per step with ticks_per_step boundaries; fixed mode yields a single governing entry

requested_state.mechanism: apply_weather_and_verify compares requested to effective and raises WeatherApplicationError on mismatch
requested_state.verified_by_test: test_weather_not_applied_is_fail_closed (a world that silently ignores set_weather must not read as applied)

live_readback_state.reason: requires a running CARLA server; none available
live_readback_state.offline_analogue: the readback path is exercised with a duck-typed world that honours and one that ignores set_weather

identity_in_paired_run_evidence.mechanism: validate_arm_weather_binding(manual_sha, auto_sha, pair_sha, manual_present, auto_present) requires both arm identities and equality with the pair digest; a missing or empty arm identity cannot be rescued by a hand-edited top-level digest

camera_response_not_confused_with_weathe.detail: camera_response.py owns photometric sensor attributes; weather_spec.py owns world weather. Candidate B added both and they do not overlap; NEW-333 defaults to the strict pinhole/postprocess-disabled baseline rather than implicit CARLA defaults.
